question: The president of which country was the chief guest at the Indian Republic Day Ceremony of 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Egypt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **President of Egypt, Abdel Fattah El-Sisi**, was invited as the **Chief Guest** for the Indian **Republic Day Ceremony 2023**.
 
• This was a significant moment as it marked the **first time** the President of Egypt was invited for this prestigious occasion.
 
• The visit symbolized the **strengthening of bilateral relations** between India and Egypt.
 
• India and Egypt share a long history of cooperation, including being part of the **Non-Aligned Movement** during the Cold War era.
 
• In 2022, both nations celebrated **75 years of diplomatic relations**, showcasing mutual respect and collaboration in various fields like **trade, defense, and culture**.
 
• The Republic Day Parade of 2023 featured Egyptian **military contingents** for the first time, symbolizing **military cooperation** and shared strategic interests.
 
• India is one of Egypt's largest trading partners in Asia, with bilateral trade exceeding **USD 7.2 billion** in recent years.
 
• The visit also focused on expanding partnerships in areas like **renewable energy, agriculture, IT, and tourism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lebanon**__

 __
 
• **Lebanon** is a country in the **Middle East**, known for its rich cultural and historical heritage.
 
• It is situated on the eastern shore of the **Mediterranean Sea**, with Beirut as its capital.
 
• Although not directly linked to the Republic Day Ceremony of India, Lebanon has historical trade and cultural exchanges with India.
 
 
 
• **Sudan**__
 __
 
• **Sudan** is located in **Northeast Africa** and is known for its ancient history and archaeological treasures, including pyramids.
 
• While Sudan shares regional significance with Egypt, it was not involved in the Republic Day 2023 event.
 
• India and Sudan have friendly relations, with cooperation in areas like **education, health, and capacity building**.
 
 
 
• **Morocco**__
 
 
• **Morocco** is a country in **North Africa**, known for its vibrant culture, historical sites, and diverse landscapes.
 
• Morocco has strong diplomatic ties with India, but it was not related to the 2023 Republic Day Ceremony.
 
• India and Morocco collaborate in areas like **phosphates, fertilizers, and education**.
